outcome: density of S-100, NSE, PGP9.5, NF, and SP immunoreactive nerve fibers
cohort: The study included 30 patients diagnosed with abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) and 17 patients who had undergone laparotomy without any history of endometriosis.
finding: AWE lesions had a significantly higher density of S-100, NSE, and PGP9.5 immunoreactive nerve fibers and a higher proportion of SP positivity compared to standard abdominal wall scars, but no significant difference in NF-immunoreactive nerve fibers or correlation with pain scores.
